title: Major Shareholder Announcement
summary: Pursuant to section 30 of the Danish Capital Markets Act, TORM plc (Nasdaq: TRMD or TRMD A) hereby announces that: Oaktree Capital Group Holdings GP, LLC (Oaktree) has notified TORM plc that, following a change in the ownership structure of OCM Njord Holdings S. r.l. (Njord Luxco), Oaktree no longer indirectly holds any shares or voting rights in TORM plc as of 31 July 2026. As part of the transaction, Brookfield Corporation has become the ultimate controlling shareholder of Njord Luxco. Njord Luxcos direct ownership interest in TORM plc remains unchanged. Njord Luxco continues to hold 20,329,874 Class A shares in TORM plc, each with a nominal value of USD 0.01, representing 19.86% of TORM plcs total share capital and voting rights.
